purpose: Diagnostic repeat of tuning trials flagged by execution monitoring, not additional model selection
selection_rule: All tuning trials with observed competing Python load, plus the trial completed before monitoring began, in execution_audit.json available after the first six formal runs
use: Compare runtime, updates, and validation loss to original trials. Preserve original selected.json and all formal models regardless of diagnostic outcome. Report whether the original selection margin is sensitive; do not use held-out test sets for these diagnostics.
